description: This file defines enums, types, and actions related to file item interactions within a web component, such as attaching, detaching, deleting, downloading, renaming, toggling protection, and previewing files.

methods.name: FileItemActionType
methods.description: An enum listing the different types of actions that can be performed on a file item.

methods.name: FileItemAction
methods.description: A discriminated union type representing different action objects that can be dispatched relating to file items.
